description: Election Commission - S. P. D. Madushankha Elected as Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Council - O. V. S. Vitharana Elected as Vice Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Coucil
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in the offices of Chairman and Vice Chairman of the Embilipitiya Urban Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of elected officials through established electoral procedures. The content falls under election-related matters rather than general government personnel changes, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
